title: Enhancing quantum processor capabilities during idle times
summary: We advocate an alternative paradigm to operate quantum computers that utilizes multipartite entanglement generated in dedicated auxiliary systems during idle times. This stored entanglement enhances the future capabilities of the quantum processor, as it can be flexibly used to assist and speed-up computations when needed. We identify classes of multipartite entangled resource states whose computational power are related to their entanglement features, and in turn to the complexity to generate them.
